duration.resume_from: baseline 20000-iteration model plus optimizer and RNG

diagnostic_basis.interpretation: Residual fitting/optimization difficulty and size sensitivity justify testing duration and width separately. These observations do not establish either cause. Seed4 additionally has a substantial train/held-out gap.

decision.limits: Equal iterations are not equal training compute. Paired intervention estimates concern seeds 0/1/2, not a five-seed rescue claim. Original five-seed outcomes remain unchanged.
